summary.text: Lisa Keller is the Democratic candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
She is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Keller graduated from East Anchorage High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oregon in 1986.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in Anchorage, has lived in District 13 for more than thirty years, and has worked as a coach and small business owner, and that she worked for Representatives Andy Josephson and Alyse Galvin in Juneau.
Keller named public safety, education and fiscal responsibility as her three campaign messages.
